chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام said:
"Whoever pays the full zakat on his wealth and places it in its proper place will not be questioned about from where he acquired his wealth."

key_terms.تَامَّةً: completely and in full, without deficiency
key_terms.زَكَاةَ: the obligatory alms due on wealth
key_terms.مَالِهِ: his wealth or property subject to zakat
key_terms.مَوْضِعِهَا: its proper place, meaning its rightful and designated recipients or use

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of paying zakat fully and distributing it properly?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when a person fully gives the zakat due on his wealth and distributes it in its proper place, he is spared questioning regarding the source of that wealth. It emphasizes the legal and moral weight of properly discharging zakat as a purifier and regulator of wealth.
